### EagleBank Appoints Corey Muñoz Chief People Officer


October 22, 2026


Seasoned executive brings global leadership experience to advance EagleBank’s people strategy and support long-term growth


BETHESDA, Md., Oct. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- EagleBank (NASDAQ: EGBN), one of the largest community banks in the Washington, D.C. region, today announced the appointment of Corey S. Muñoz, Ph.D., as Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer, effective November 16, 2026.


Muñoz will join EagleBank’s executive leadership team and report directly to Chief Executive Officer and President Stephen Curley. He will shape the people strategy and develop the leadership and organizational capabilities needed to advance the Bank’s strategic plan and support sustainable growth.


“EagleBank’s continued success will be shaped by our ability to attract, develop and retain exceptional people,” said Stephen Curley, President and Chief Executive Officer of Eagle Bancorp and EagleBank. “Corey brings deep experience transforming complex organizations, strengthening leadership pipelines and aligning talent strategy with business priorities. His appointment reinforces our commitment to developing the leadership and capabilities that will support our growth and advance our strategic plan.”


“EagleBank has built a strong franchise and distinctive culture through its people, customer relationships and commitment to the communities it serves,” said Muñoz. “I look forward to building on that foundation by developing talent, creating opportunities for employees and supporting the Bank’s long-term success.”


**Executive Background**


Most recently, Muñoz served as Global Vice President, People & Organization at Mars, Incorporated, where he led talent development strategies serving more than 140,000 associates across 80-plus countries and expanded organizational capabilities through technology and AI-enabled learning systems.


Previously, he was Partner, People & Culture at KPMG, leading talent management, employee engagement, leadership development and organizational transformation. As the New Jersey Office Managing Partner, he also oversaw operations and employee engagement for approximately 2,200 professionals.


Earlier, Muñoz was Vice President of Human Resources for Corporate Offices and Wholesale Banking at TD Bank Group, directing talent strategy, leadership development and succession planning across Risk, Finance, Legal and Wholesale Banking. He also held senior human resources and leadership development roles at BAE Systems.


Muñoz holds a Ph.D. in Industrial/Organizational Psychology and an M.S. in Psychology from the University of Georgia, a B.A. in Psychology from Oklahoma State University and an Executive Coaching Certification from Columbia University.

About Eagle Bancorp, Inc. and EagleBank
Eagle Bancorp, Inc. is the holding company for EagleBank, which commenced operations in 1998. EagleBank is headquartered in Bethesda, Maryland, and conducts full service commercial banking through 12 offices, located in Suburban, Maryland, Washington, D.C. and Northern Virginia. EagleBank focuses on building relationships with businesses, professionals and individuals in its marketplace.
